newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Gunbattle rages as 500 prisoners riot in Honduras.
newsitem.headline: Gunbattle rages as 500 prisoners riot in Honduras.

text.p: Troops clashed with rioting inmates at a jail in southern Honduras on Thursday and five prisoners and two guards were injured in a prolonged exchange of fire, officials said.
They said the riots broke out late on Wednesday during a power cut and prisoners seized control of sections of the jail and set one of its offices alight.
Police said they had captured the ringleaders but the stand-off between prisoners and troops was continuing.
"We have captured the leaders of the riot...but there is still a group inside that does not want to talk and they are the ones that have been shooting at us," Lt. Norman Padilla told reporters.
"We have captured around 30 prisoners who were trying to escape," he added.
Police and army troops have surrounded the jail in the city of Choluteca, 70 miles (110 km) south of the capital, to avoid a mass breakout.
